title: Engr IV-Security Engineering
description:
When you join Verizon
   

  

 You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.
   

  

****What you’ll be doing...****
 The Verizon Cyber Security Team is looking for a highly skilled Security Engineer (Engr IV) to drive our Red Team and Adversary Simulation capability within Technology Product Development (TPD). In this role, you will elevate our offensive security posture beyond standard vulnerability discovery. Your mission is to rigorously test our organization's People, Processes, and Technology against realistic, advanced threats. We do not exist merely to find missing patches; we act as a catalyst to ensure Verizon is resilient against the threats of tomorrow.
   

  

 This team rejects the notion that Red Teaming is defined by a checklist of scanners. We are looking for a true builder\-hacker hybrid—someone who natively speaks the language of modern software engineering and treats offensive operations as an engineering discipline. You will prioritize strategy over tooling, emulating adversary Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) to test our Threat Management Center's (TMC) detection pipelines. You will operate as a true partner, culminating campaigns with collaborative Purple Team exercises to empower developers to build secure, resilient products from the ground up while enforcing strict cyber hygiene across the enterprise.
   

  

* Execute Adversary Simulations: Design and execute complex, objective\-based Red Team campaigns modeled on real\-world adversaries targeting the telecom industry, utilizing the MITRE ATT\&CK framework.
* Target Modern Architectures \& AI Ecosystems: Focus attacks on the modern software supply chain, full\-stack applications (Node, Angular, Java), and cloud environments. Participate in offensive engagements against AI\-driven applications, including testing Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, custom LLM agents, and human\-in\-the\-loop (HITL) validations.
* Validate Cyber Hygiene \& Compliance: Look beyond complex exploit chains to identify and expose systemic failures in foundational cyber hygiene. Map campaign findings against enterprise security policies and regulatory compliance requirements to prove where technical controls are failing.
* AI\-Augmented Offensive Operations: Actively leverage generative AI and modern tooling to accelerate vulnerability research, automate custom payload generation, and enhance red team workflows.
* Test Detection and Response: Operate with stealth and precision to evaluate Verizon's logging, alerting, and incident response pipelines in real\-time, focusing on "Living off the Land" methodologies.
* Drive True Purple Teaming: Embrace a Gray/White\-box methodology by collaborating closely with product and development teams. Conduct post\-campaign replay exercises with the Blue Team and developers to build robust detection rules and secure coding practices.
* Manage Attack Infrastructure as Code: Deploy and maintain dedicated, external cloud attack infrastructure (AWS/GCP) off\-network using automated CI/CD pipelines to mirror sophisticated threat actors.
* Enforce Uncompromising RoE: Adhere to explicit Rules of Engagement, ensure comprehensive asset inventories, and maintain strict operational safety and legal compliance during all engagements.
* Mentorship \& Collaboration: Provide technical guidance and peer mentorship to junior Red Team operators and penetration testers.


**What We’re Looking For…**
 You’ll need to have:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree with four or more years of work experience in a relevant security field.
* Four or more years of dedicated, hands\-on experience in Red Teaming, adversary simulation, or advanced penetration testing.
* Should have one of these core offensive security certifications: OSCP, CRTO, CRTP, or GXPN.
* Understanding of the MITRE ATT\&CK framework, Threat Intelligence integration, and APT emulation, including experience bypassing modern EDR/XDR solutions.
* Development experience with enterprise tech stacks (specifically Node.js, Angular, and Java) to conduct white\-box source code reviews, exploit complex web applications, and build bespoke attack tooling.
* Applied knowledge of AI security risks and usage, including prompt engineering, LLM jailbreaking, manipulating AI agent frameworks/APIs (e.g., MCP), and using AI models to accelerate offensive workflows.
* Knowledge of enterprise cyber hygiene principles, industry security frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, CIS Controls), and experience translating offensive findings into actionable data for compliance, risk, and audit stakeholders.
* Expertise in configuring and safely utilizing Command and Control (C2\) frameworks (e.g., Cobalt Strike, Mythic, Sliver).
* Demonstrated experience in collaborative Purple Teaming, translating technical attack narratives into actionable detection engineering rules.


 Even better if you have one or more of the following:
   

  

* A Master's degree in a relevant technical field.
* In\-depth knowledge of securing and attacking cloud\-native architectures, containerization platforms (Docker, Kubernetes), and modern CI/CD pipelines.
* Highly recognized advanced certifications such as OSEP, OSWE, OSED, or advanced cloud security architecture certifications.
* Proficiency in programming and scripting languages (such as C\#, C\+\+, Go, Rust, Python, Bash, or PowerShell) to develop custom implants, droppers, and evasive tooling.
* A solid understanding of continuous attack surface management methodologies and advanced OSINT collection.
* Familiarity with regulatory compliance frameworks relevant to the telecommunications industry (e.g., SOX, PCI\-DSS, CPNI).
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into clear, actionable risks for management and engineering teams.


 If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.
   

  

 Where you’ll be working
   

  

 In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

 40
   

  

 Equal Employment Opportunity
   

  

 Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

 ESAP and operational compliance

 Workforce supply chain and community

 · Oversee community engagement, external grievances, exclusion\-list screening and E\&S requirements for contractors and material suppliers.
 



  




 Governance training and assurance

title: AI Advisory and Governance Lead
description:
**About IDinsight**
*We're a global data and evidence advisory, working with governments, philanthropies, and non\-profits to improve lives at scale, using technology and AI where they can deliver the most impact.*
 IDinsight is a global nonprofit that equips leaders with the data, evidence, and technology to improve lives at scale. We partner with governments, NGOs, multilaterals, and funders to support decisions at every stage of their impact journey – from bold pilots to nationwide scale\-ups. Our teams bring rigorous evidence and practical insights so leaders can make informed decisions that truly change lives. With our partners, we are pioneering the next frontier of social impact, where data and technology accelerate progress for millions. We help leaders overcome the three main barriers to impact:
   

  

* Figuring out what works
* Learning and improving
* Reaching and operating at scale


 We work in multiple countries across Asia and Africa. Our work spans a wide range of sectors, including agriculture, education, health, governance, sanitation, financial inclusion, and other areas.
   

  

 We have expertise in a variety of rigorous approaches and methodologies, which we tailor to each client depending on their needs and constraints. To achieve a positive social impact, we:
   

  

* Support our partners with the full ‘data and evidence’ value chain – from primary data collection to data systems, monitoring, evaluation, and learning tools, and data science
* Inform funding decisions – toward high\-impact initiatives and away from less effective programs or approaches
* Create cutting\-edge AI\-for\-good products that make the delivery of social interventions and learning tools more cost\-effective and scalable


 Our diverse, growing team of roughly 250 outstanding colleagues operates in nearly two dozen countries around the world. Learn more about our mission and values at
 **www.IDinsight.org** 
 .
   

  

****Joining IDinsight at this moment****
 IDinsight is entering an exciting new phase of growth. As demand for rigorous evidence and AI\-enabled solutions accelerates across the sectors and geographies we work in, we are actively investing in our teams, deepening our regional footprint, and expanding the frontier of what data and technology can do for social impact. This is a moment of real momentum for IDinsight. We're looking for people who want to use data and evidence to improve lives at scale; who are energized by taking on problems without a playbook; and who want a hand in shaping what IDinsight becomes as we grow.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are hiring an entrepreneurial senior leader to strengthen and develop our AI Advisory practice for government and social sector clients in India. You will collaborate with IDinsight’s Senior Leadership, Executive, and Data Science teams to develop AI and technology aspects of current engagements, develop new engagements primarily with government partners, and support delivery of projects. Read more about our AI strategy.
   

  

 The role is particularly suited to someone who understands technology transformation and policymaking in Indian government institutions. It combines client\-facing advisory work with business development, and sits at the intersection of AI, governance, and public sector consulting. The role will ideally be based in Delhi, or require substantial time spent in Delhi.
   

  

****What you will do****
**Lead policy advisory and AI support for governments**
 Support IDinsight's current government partners navigate the intersection of technology, AI, and policy, and grow our portfolio by engaging new government departments/agencies in AI and policy advisory.
   

  

* Policy advisory on AI: Support current and new government partners in:
+ Design and deployment of tech\-enabled systems, including AI\-native tools, data systems, and digital platforms — with a grounded understanding of requirements and constraints in Indian government settings, including data governance, procurement constraints, interoperability, and the political economy of adoption.
+ Developing policies, regulations, governance and capacity building frameworks shaping AI use in India.
+ Translating broad questions around into concrete, impactful opportunities and recommendations

* Client engagement: Participate in high\-level meetings, workshops, and consortium discussions with government officials, funders, and partner organisations as a credible voice on technology, AI, and AI policy in governance contexts.
* Government client development: Identify and develop new opportunities to support governments on AI and technology, through active origination of new AI advisory engagements, conversion of leads, and drafting and reviewing proposals, growing the practice's pipeline and revenue especially with government organisations
* Represent IDinsight externally through thought leadership and public communications (blog posts, conference presentations, sector convenings, and written outputs) that advance IDinsight's profile and influence on AI transformation.


**Develop new AI advisory and evaluation engagements**
 Grow IDinsight's AI advisory and evaluation practice with NGOs, social enterprises, and foundations.
   

  

* Client development: Identify, scope, and structure new engagements. Build relationships with prospective partners and develop proposals that match IDinsight's capabilities to client needs.
* AI Transformation Advisory: Serve as the senior lead on advisory and evaluation engagements \- identifying the right use\-cases; building, testing and evaluating AI\-based products; and integrating AI products responsibly into client systems and workflows.
* Thought leadership: Represent IDinsight in sector conversations on AI in the social sector through writing and external engagement.
* Training and workshops: Design and deliver executive workshops, workflow redesign sessions, and training programs that build lasting client capability.


**Financial management**
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of IDinsight's business model and contribute to a financially sustainable practice through sound strategic decision\-making and resource stewardship.
* Review budget design and resource allocation, ensuring financial planning supports quality delivery, funder expectations, and growth of the practice.
* Build trust with clients and funders through timely, accurate, and strategic financial reporting.


****Who we are looking for****
**Qualifications**
* Commitment to IDinsight's values and mission
* 6\-10 years of professional experience, with significant time in consulting, digital transformation, product management, or technology implementation, ideally serving governments, foundations, or social sector organizations.
* Technical fluency: Strong understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations, AI agent architectures, and the practical realities of deploying AI in organizations. Ability to credibly direct a technical team. The role does not require production coding skills.
* Direct experience working with Indian government: Ideally ministries, national commissions, or large national programmes, with a strong understanding of how decisions get made and how change actually happens in these institutions, and the requirements that technology and AI systems must meet in government settings
* Client\-facing consulting: Experience leading complex advisory engagements, managing senior client relationships, and delivering results against defined success metrics.
* People management: Track record of building, managing, and developing high\-performing teams that include both technical and non\-technical roles.
* Demonstrated experience in client development: identifying opportunities, scoping engagements, developing proposals, and building relationships with senior stakeholders.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments with limited structure
* Entrepreneurial\- can identify an opportunity and build from it without waiting for a fully defined brief.
* Strong communicator who can adapt between technical, bureaucratic, and donor audiences.


****Professional development****
 Skill and career development are core to IDinsight's values and long\-term impact strategy, and have been noted highlights of teammates’ experiences. IDinsighters receive significant mentorship from IDinsight leadership, support from talented peers, and are given considerable autonomy when ready. They maintain professional development plans and are given "stretch" opportunities designed to strengthen a variety of skills. Real\-time feedback is embedded in our culture and formal structure enables maximum professional growth. Additionally, teammates have access to an annual professional development stipend that they are encouraged to utilize to explore their career interests and develop their skills.
   

  

****Nuts \& bolts****
****Location****
 This position is based in IDinsight’s Delhi office. Candidates should be willing to relocate to Delhi or travel substantially, often on short notice.
   

  

**Start dates**
 We would prefer for the candidate to start immediately and in light of the urgency would be evaluating applications on a rolling basis.
   

  

****References****
 Applications should include three references, including email, phone, and title. Briefly state in what capacity you worked with each reference.
   

  

****Work authorization****
**If you’re not willing to sponsor work authorization:** 
 IDinsight is not able to sponsor work authorization for this role. Successful candidates will not require IDinsight to sponsor their work authorization in the office in which they'll be based.
   

  

**If you’re willing to sponsor work authorization:** 
 IDinsight is able to sponsor employment visas for all nationalities in these locations; however, we will prioritize candidates who do not require IDinsight to sponsor work authorization in the aforementioned countries. All candidates who are not currently located in our country offices listed above will be expected to relocate to their office locations at the onset of their employment.
   

  

**Compensation \& Benefits**
 Compensation and benefits are commensurate with the qualifications and experiences IDinsight is hiring for, and competitive within the global development sector. We are especially proud of the people\-focused benefits we offer including comprehensive international health insurance, including mental health coverage; paid vacation, sick, and parental leave; relocation benefits; a travel stipend; technology and work from home stipends; a professional development budget; and more.
   

  

 Please note, as a non\-profit, we are unable to provide compensation similar to leading private sector organizations.
   

  

****How to apply****
 This application includes several questions and requires a CV (one to two pages) covering your professional and personal experience as well as academic qualifications. Please omit headshots, parental details, birth dates, marital status, and similar personal information — these aren't relevant to our review.
   

  

 More information, including details on I
 **Dinsight’s hiring process** 
 and
 **frequently asked questions** 
 , can be found online at IDinsight Careers. Any questions should be directed to india.careers@IDinsight.org.
   

  

****IDinsight’s commitment to reducing power asymmetries****
 IDinsight is committed to
 **reducing power asymmetries in the social sector** 
 . Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion reflects our understanding of the need for the sector to abandon unhealthy practices of the past. We wish to be part of a new generation of international NGOs who are honest about this history and transparent about our role in the present. Our commitment is also aligned with the impact of our work.
   

  

 We seek a diverse workforce that inherently embodies our commitment to fostering inclusivity. This also helps us refine and improve our methods and relationships and strengthen the services we provide our clients and their communities or constituencies. The following commitments represent our vision for the IDinsight team:
   

  

* IDinsight will have greater representation from the populations with whom we work and the clients we serve.
* IDinsight will have greater representation from the countries in which we work.
* Across all countries in which we recruit, we will seek greater representation from historically excluded communities.
* IDinsight will foster an inclusive work culture that empowers a diverse team to do their best work.


 IDinsight is committed to non\-discrimination in our recruitment, employment practices, and organizational culture, regardless of people’s age, disability, gender identity, national origin, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law.

About Us

Greyy Elephant Ideaz Private Limited is a real\-estate company. We are looking for a property lawyer to join our in\-house team and take ownership of the legal side of our property transactions, from due diligence to documentation.

Role Overview

You will be the company's go\-to legal expert on property matters. You will verify titles, draft and vet agreements, manage legal risk on land and property acquisitions, and work with our business, finance, and project teams so deals close cleanly and on time.

Key Responsibilities

**Title Due Diligence and Chain of Title**

* Examine title documents and trace the complete chain of title for land and properties under consideration
* Review sale deeds, conveyance deeds, gift and partition deeds, wills, and power of attorney documents
* Verify revenue records (jamabandi, mutation entries, khasra/khatauni, etc.), encumbrance certificates, and municipal and development authority records
* Identify defects, encumbrances, litigation, and boundary or possession issues, and recommend how to resolve them
* Prepare clear legal title reports and risk summaries for management

**Drafting and Documentation**

* Draft, review, and negotiate agreements to sell, sale deeds, lease and license agreements, joint development and collaboration agreements, development agreements, and MOUs
* Prepare allotment letters, buyer agreements, and other customer\-facing documents in line with applicable law
* Draft legal notices, replies, affidavits, indemnities, and undertakings
* Maintain standard templates and clause libraries to speed up recurring transactions

**Transaction and Compliance Support**

* Support land acquisition and property purchase and sale from due diligence through registration
* Coordinate stamp duty payment, registration, and mutation work with sub\-registrar offices and authorities
* Ensure compliance with RERA and other applicable real\-estate, land\-use, and local regulations
* Assist with approvals, licenses, and NOCs required for projects

**Litigation and Dispute Management**

* Monitor property\-related disputes and coordinate with external counsel on litigation, arbitration, and recovery matters
* Brief external advocates, track case status, and report to management
* Advise on pre\-litigation strategy and settlements

**Advisory and Internal Coordination**

* Give day\-to\-day legal advice to management and business teams
* Flag legal risks early and suggest practical solutions
* Maintain organized, secure records of all title documents and legal files

Requirements

**Must have**

* LL.B. (LL.M. preferred) from a recognized university, enrolled with a State Bar Council
* Proven experience in property law, ideally as an in\-house counsel or with a real\-estate developer or firm
* Strong hands\-on experience in **title search and title chain verification**
* Strong **drafting** skills for property agreements and deeds
* Solid knowledge of the Transfer of Property Act, Registration Act, Indian Stamp Act, RERA, and relevant state land laws
* Ability to read and interpret revenue and land records

**Good to have**

* Experience with land acquisition, joint ventures, or large\-scale development projects
* Exposure to property litigation and RERA proceedings
* Working knowledge of Hindi and English, written and spoken

Skills and Attributes

* Meticulous attention to detail and sound legal judgment
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication
* Ability to explain legal issues to non\-legal colleagues
* Good negotiation skills
* Ownership, integrity, and the ability to handle multiple matters at once

* Provide practical, business\-oriented legal guidance while ensuring appropriate risk management.

**Experience**

* Experience in retail, consumer, FMCG, e\-commerce or other consumer\-facing businesses will be preferred.
* Strong exposure to commercial contract drafting and review is required.
* Experience in handling legal, regulatory, litigation, IPR and company secretarial matters.


**Technical Skills**
* Strong knowledge of commercial contracts and legal documentation.
* Good understanding of applicable corporate and commercial laws.
* Exposure to statutory and regulatory compliance management.
* Knowledge of litigation and dispute management processes.
* Understanding of intellectual property / trademark matters.
* Working knowledge of Company Secretarial and corporate governance requirements.
* Familiarity with data privacy laws and their business application will be an advantage.
* Exposure to Legal Metrology regulations will be an advantage.

* Sound analytical and problem\-solving ability.
* Strong attention to detail and risk orientation.
* Ability to interpret legislation and translate legal requirements into practical business advice.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Strong negotiation and influencing skills.

* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic business environment.

* Timely management of litigation and external legal counsel.
* Effective regulatory and legal compliance.
* Protection of Skechers' intellectual property and brand interests.
* Strong corporate governance and company secretarial support.
* Increased legal and compliance awareness across business teams.
* Timely identification and escalation of legal and regulatory risks.

 This role offers an opportunity to work closely with a growing, consumer\-facing organization and gain broad exposure across

**About Skechers**
 Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e\-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

 Our client is a large, listed Indian building materials company with a brand that goes back several decades, a national dealer and retail network, and manufacturing in Gujarat and Maharashtra. Most of its sales go through dealers and project customers on credit. As a result, it carries a steady stream of recovery matters, consumer complaints, and commercial and labour cases, spread across forums and handled by many external counsel. The Company wants one owner for this whole caseload. This person will know every matter, run the important ones personally, and turn disputes into money recovered and exposure closed.
 



**What you will own** 




*Portfolio and control* 



* Set up a single litigation and recovery register within the first 90 days. It will cover every pending matter with forum, counsel, exposure, next date and a realistic outcome, and will be reviewed monthly with Finance. \[confirm: current number of matters]
* Recover ₹\[confirm] crore of aged dealer and project receivables within 18 months, using Section 138 NI Act complaints, Order XXXVII summary suits, arbitration and Section 9 IBC applications, whichever gets the best result.
* Rationalise the external counsel panel and cut outside legal spend by \[confirm]%. This means fixed\-fee arrangements, clear briefs and accountability for every appearance.



*Hands\-on practice* 



* Personally draft or settle the key pleadings, legal notices, replies and written statements. You will not only brief counsel and forward their work.
* Attend key hearings, mediations and settlement meetings in person, including outside Mumbai when a matter needs it.
* Defend consumer commission cases about product quality and installation, working with the QC and customer care teams to build the technical record.



*Prevention* 



* Feed dispute patterns back into dealer, project and supply agreements. This includes security instruments, personal guarantees, credit terms, jurisdiction and arbitration clauses.
* Train regional sales and credit teams on documentation that holds up in a recovery action.



**What you bring** 




*Must have* 



* LLB and enrolment with a State Bar Council.
* 8–12 years' post\-qualification experience, at least 4 of them in\-house at a manufacturing, consumer durables or building products company. \[confirm: PQE band]

* Has managed a portfolio of 100\+ live matters across multiple states and forums. \[confirm: threshold]
* Experience instructing and managing external counsel on fees, briefing and outcomes.



*Strongly preferred* 



* Arbitration practice under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, including enforcement of awards.
* IBC exposure as an operational creditor, and MSMED Act claims.
* Consumer commission practice at the district and state levels.
* Early career in a litigation chamber or disputes practice in Mumbai.



**What we look for beyond the CV** 



* You do the work yourself. When a pleading matters, you draft it; you do not wait for a draft to come back.
* You measure your success by money recovered and matters closed, not by matters "being monitored".
* You can sit across the table from a dealer or contractor and negotiate a settlement that is commercially sensible and still enforceable.
* You keep a clean, current record. Anyone should be able to ask for the status of any matter and get an answer the same day.



**Reporting and structure** 




 Reports to the General Counsel / Head – Legal. Leads \[confirm: team size, e.g. 1–2 legal executives]. Works closely with Finance and Credit Control, regional sales heads, Customer Care and QC, HR (on labour matters) and the company secretarial team.

description:
**Overview**
 The primary responsibilities of this position are to assist the Trade Compliance Manager in the development, implementation and maintenance of both import and export compliance programs and GTS. Strong emphasis on supporting regulatory Import/Export compliance and interfacing with Groups, Divisions and employees at all levels of the organization to include training, developing and advising upper management and staff.
   

  

 The Trade Compliance Specialist is a subject matter expert in one or more specific areas of the law such as HTS Classification, Customs Valuation, Country of Origin Determination, Broker Management, etc.
   

  

 The Trade Compliance Specialist Acts as a liaison between end\-users, IT, and other cross functional teams and professionals in the analysis, design, configuration, testing and maintenance of systems to ensure optimal operational performance including but not limited to GTS.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Supports projects focused on improving import/export operations and processes in the APAC region, coordinates with Customer Service and Logistics to troubleshoot problem orders/shipments
* Maintains and assists with the creation and implementation of Bio\-Rad’s export and import compliance procedures and work instructions
* Responsible for broker compliance verification via auditing import/export transactions and files
* Performs Customs compliance audits and reports audit results
* Exercises judgement with latitude to propose and implement improvements in the Trade Compliance policies
* Subject matter expert in one or multiple areas of the law such as HTS, Origin, Valuation, Transfer Price, Free Trade Agreements, Duty Drawback, Free Trade Zones
* Assigns HTS classifications, Dual use classifications, requests Other Government Agency (OGA) import product information/data necessary for importation and assists in the country\-of\-origin determination for manufactured and purchased products imported and exported by Bio\-Rad
* Administers import/export recordkeeping requirements
* Performs Free Trade Agreement Analysis
* Performs SAP Global Trade Services (GTS) Sanctioned Party Listing (SPL) screening
* Supports the coordination of import/export shipments with the Logistics and Compliance departments
* Sets up restrictions in SAP GTS for import/export compliance concerns, and manages shipments with export restrictions, manages Global Trade Services (GTS) module of SAP
* Provides necessary import/export compliance training to operational personnel
* Responsible for analyzing and interpreting export and import regulations and provides risks assessments and advice related to business activities
* Develop business processes to address compliance risks
* Supports the Global Trade Compliance and Global Logistics organization on the implementation of Global Trade Automation Systems
* Acts as a liaison between end\-users, IT and other cross functional teams and professionals in the analysis, design, configuration, testing and maintenance of systems to ensure optimal operational performance
* Works on projects and tasks that are local and regional in scope and impact with medium to significant complexity. Supports projects focused on improving business operations and processes
* Develop presentations and effectively communicate results with recommended action plans to management
* Uses data analysis/modeling to create new reports, troubleshoots and modify existing reports including Target KPIs, cost savings opportunities, etc.

* Supports internal audit procedures

* Identifies and documents business risks
* Maintains awareness of industry and market trends through ongoing research


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in International Business, Business Administration, Business Information or related discipline
* Minimum 7 years of experience in a similar position (data management, dynamic Global Trade), ideally experienced working in bio\-pharma, medical or life science related companies
* Knowledge of trade compliance regulations in more than one country
* Advanced quantitative skills with proficiency in data analysis (SAP/MS Access) modeling (MS Excel) and presenting (MS PowerPoint), advanced skills in Microsoft Excel and tools such as PowerBI
* Expert knowledgeable about how to qualify items under various Free Trade agreements, Customs Reconciliation \& Duty Reductions Program
* Skill in creating statistical reporting, including skill in composing logical, detailed and analytical reports, ability to create presentations and present to technical and non\-technical audiences.
